title: Personal Injury Case Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced, organized, and proactive Case Manager that also speaks SPANISH (this is a plus but not mandatory) to join our growing personal injury team. The Case Manager will be responsible for handling a caseload of pre-litigation files from intake through settlement or trial support. This role is central to ensuring that each client’s case progresses smoothly, efficiently, and in full compliance with California legal requirements.



Key Responsibilities:



Case Intake & Client Onboarding



Conduct initial intake calls with potential clients at any time

Explain the representation process, gather facts, and assess case viability

Ensure all necessary intake forms, authorizations, and documents are completed

Open and set up new case files in case management system



File & Case Management



Serve as primary point of contact for clients throughout the life of the case

Maintain organized and up-to-date digital files using firm case management software

Track all case deadlines, SOLs, medical treatment status, lien info, and key events

Draft letters of representation and send to insurance companies, employers, and medical providers

Coordinate communications with insurance adjusters, medical providers, and other parties



Medical & Records Management



Assist clients in locating appropriate medical providers

Monitor medical treatment and keep detailed notes of client progress

Request and follow up on medical records and bills

Organize medical records chronologically and summarize treatment history

Track and negotiate medical liens (e.g., MedPay, health insurance, hospital liens, third-party)

Insurance & Settlement Support

Submit demands with supporting documentation under attorney supervision

Track offers, counteroffers, and communicate updates to clients

Prepare case summaries for settlement negotiations

Draft settlement memos, disbursement breakdowns, and closing documentation



Required Qualifications:



Minimum 2 years of experience in personal injury law (case manager, paralegal, or similar role)

Knowledge of California personal injury laws and procedures

Strong understanding of medical terminology and records

Excellent communication and client service skills

Strong time management and organizational abilities

Proficiency in legal case management software (e.g., Filevine)

Fluent in English; bilingual in Spanish is a strong plus

Familiarity with pre-litigation and litigation processes

title: Project Manager – Email Marketing & CRM Operations
description:

The Role:

As our Project Manager, you will be the operational bridge between our client specifications and our campaign execution. You will start by mastering our proprietary tech stack—a robust internal CRM equipped with advanced
 delivery capabilities and integrated SMTPs.



Once you know the system inside and out, your primary objective will be to map the entire operational lifecycle, build comprehensive training documentation, and onboard a team of operators. You will then manage this team to ensure all client campaigns are executed flawlessly and on schedule.



Key Responsibilities:

- System Mastery: Dive deep into our internal CRM and proprietary
 delivery tools to understand the full technical and operational workflow of our lead retargeting processes.

- Process Engineering & Documentation: Map out the end-to-end campaign lifecycle. Create clear, highly detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and training materials for our internal systems.

- Team Onboarding & Leadership: Use the documentation you create to successfully onboard, train, and manage a team of campaign operators.

- Operational Management: Oversee the daily execution of
 marketing campaigns. Ensure operators are strictly adhering to client specifications and internal quality standards.

- Cross-Functional Troubleshooting: Act as the first line of defense for operational bottlenecks, ensuring our integrated SMTPs and CRM tools are being leveraged efficiently by the team.



Who We Are Looking For:

- CRM &
 Marketing Expertise: You have proven experience managing projects within a CRM,
 marketing, or high-volume lead generation environment.

- Technical Aptitude: You are highly comfortable learning new, proprietary software. You understand the fundamental mechanics of
 delivery systems (experience with SMTPs is a major advantage).

- Systems Thinker: You excel at breaking down complex, multi-step technical processes into simple, teachable workflows.

- Exceptional Documenter: You have a track record of writing clear, actionable training materials and SOPs from scratch.

- Leadership Skills: You are a natural leader who can train, monitor, and hold a team of operators accountable to strict client deliverables.



Requirements:

- Minimum 1 year CRM experience

- English proficiency

title: Video Editor and Social Media Manager
description:
Job Type: [Full-Time / Part-Time]

Experience Level: Mid-to-Senior



About Us

We run a popular automotive YouTube and Instagram page for automotive enthusiasts, and have scaled to growing the pages to cater to clients and customers that demand the highest quality parts, with the utmost attention to service and details. Strong communication with our business clients is what separates us from our competition. We are looking to continue growing this business through our upcoming Social Media Manager role and professional video editor to enhance our marketing efforts through engaging content.



The Role

We are seeking a high-energy, multi-talented Video Editor & Social Media Manager with a deep passion for the automotive world. In this role, you will be the creator behind our digital presence. You will take raw footage of incredible builds, drives, or automotive content and turn it into videos that resonate with our current audience while reaching new viewers and customers. Beyond the edit bay, you will manage our community, engage with car enthusiasts, coordinate with high-profile guests/clients, and drive business growth.



The Horizon: We are looking for a true partner. If you are eager to learn, adaptable, and hungry for growth, this role will expand. You will have the unique opportunity to step up and manage the content and social strategies for our other diverse business entities as we scale.



Key Responsibilities

Automotive Video Production: Edit engaging long-form (YouTube) and short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) content. Creating videos with immersive sound design and imagery, pacing, and visual energy is key. Color grading knowledge for videos.

Photo & Asset Editing: Use Lightroom to color-grade and retouch automotive photography for thumbnails, social posts, and marketing materials.



Social Media Management: Own the content calendar across all platforms. Stay ahead of automotive trends, trending audio, and algorithm shifts to maximize engagement and improve reach.



Client & Guest Relations: Act as the face of our brand in the digital space. Manage DMs, engage authentically with the car community, and coordinate communications with customers, influencers, and industry guests.



Cross-Industry Growth: Be ready to pivot your creative skills to analyze, adapt, and build content strategies for our other business sectors as you grow with the company.



Qualifications & Skills

Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve) and Adobe Lightroom is mandatory.

Automotive Passion: You understand car culture. You know what captures the attention of enthusiasts, and how to make a vehicle look its absolute best on camera during editing and enhancement.



Elite Communication: Exceptional written skills. You can chat casually with car enthusiasts in the comments, but switch to a professional, business-minded tone when dealing with clients and guests.



The Growth Mindset: You aren't just looking to "clock in and clock out." You are ambitious, eager to learn new industries, and want to build a long-term career with us across our other lines of business.



Self-Driven: This is a 100% remote role. You must be hyper-organized, reliable, and capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines.



What We Offer

100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a strong internet connection.



Career: Opportunity to expand your portfolio and responsibilities into other business fields under our umbrella based on your performance.



Creative Freedom: Direct input into content strategy, storytelling, and brand voice.



Compensation: To be discussed based on experience, availability, working hours, with room for growth as you take on more business entities.



How to Apply

If you love content creation in the automotive space, and want to grow alongside a expanding business ecosystem, this role may be a good fit. Please include with your resume and message the following:

- A link to your portfolio/showreel featuring your best video edits and photo work (Automotive examples are a preferred, but send your work displaying your creative talent).

- A link to your profile and your resume.

- Tell us about your favorite car or a recent automotive content trend that caught your eye.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Devin Jatho-Style Short-Form Editor — Premiere Pro + After Effects | Reels, Ads & Motion Graphics
description:
We are hiring a full-time short-form video editor who lives and breathes the Devin Jatho editing style — fast-paced talking-head edits with high-retention captions, kinetic typography, smooth zooms, motion graphics, and After Effects-driven visual storytelling.



The role splits across two equally important pillars:



Paid ad creatives — Meta, TikTok, and YouTube short-form ads that hook in the first 1.5 seconds, hold attention, and convert.

Organic client content — the videos we shoot in-person for our clients (talking heads, behind-the-scenes, product showcases, branded short-form) edited into polished Reels, TikToks, and Shorts.



You'll be cutting both, so you need to understand what makes content stop the scroll and what makes an ad sell. This is not a captions-only job. If your "Devin Jatho style" stops at animated subtitles, this role isn't for you. We need someone who treats every second of a Reel or ad like a piece of visual choreography — overlays timed to sound design, B-roll cut to the beat, motion graphics that earn attention, and the taste to know when less is more.

Who We Are:

Aspire Media Productions is a content-led marketing agency based in New York, serving local service businesses, healthcare practices, law firms, and the auto aftermarket industry. We shoot premium content for our clients in-person and run paid ad campaigns to scale their results. You'll be editing across multiple niches — one day it's a Lamborghini detail shop, the next it's a wellness clinic — so adaptability matters.



What You'll Be Doing:



Editing paid ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube — hook-driven, retention-engineered, conversion-focused short-form videos

Editing organic client content from in-person shoots — 15–60 second talking-head Reels, TikToks, and Shorts in the Devin Jatho aesthetic

Producing multiple ad variations per concept (different hooks, CTAs, pacing tests)

Building animated captions with rhythm, color emphasis, and pacing that drives retention

Creating motion graphics, kinetic text reveals, and AE-based visual elements

Layering in B-roll, PNGs, emojis, sound design, and SFX with intention

Color grading talking-head footage to a clean, premium look

Owning revisions and turnaround times — you ship work that's near-final on the first pass



Required Skills:



Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro AND After Effects (non-negotiable — AE is half the job)

Strong understanding of direct-response ad creative principles — hooks, pattern interrupts, retention curves, CTAs

Ability to edit organic content that feels native to the platform, not "ad-like"

Sound design instincts (you know when to add an SFX and when to let silence hit)

High-level typography taste — captions that enhance the talking head, not distract from it

Color grading fundamentals 

Ability to match a brand style guide and edit consistently across clients



Speed: comfortable producing 3–5 polished short-form edits per week minimum, plus ad variations



Bonus Points:



Direct experience editing paid Meta or TikTok ads with documented performance (CTR, ROAS, hook rate)

Experience editing for personal brands, agencies, or content creators in the SMMA / marketing space


 / Google Drive workflow experience

Basic Photoshop or Illustrator skills for asset creation



Schedule & Setup:



Full-time contractor role (40 hrs/week)

Some overlap with US Eastern Time required (at least 3–4 hours daily)

Long-term position — we want someone we can grow with for years, not a 3-month gig



Before you apply, watch the reference videos here: 



How to Apply:

Send the following to be considered (applications missing any of these will be auto-rejected):



Your portfolio — 



direct links to 3–5 of your best Devin Jatho-style short-form edits (Google Drive, 
, YouTube, or Instagram). Include both organic content and paid ad creatives if you have them.



The phrase "I edit like Jatho" in the first line of your application so I know you read this post fully.



Your monthly rate expectation in USD.



Process:

Stage 1 ? Portfolio review

Stage 2 ? 30-min Zoom call (we'll talk through your reel and your process)

Stage 3 ? Offer



I review every application personally. Talented editors will hear back within 72 hours.

Let's build something great together.



— Hakim, Founder, Aspire Media Productions

title: Phone Sales Representative – Tree Care Services
description:
About Us 

Save The Ash Tree Co. is a growing tree injection company based in Minnesota, specializing in protecting ash trees from the Emerald Ash Borer (EAB) — a invasive beetle that has devastated millions of ash trees across North America. We're expanding rapidly into Texas, Nebraska, South Dakota, and beyond, and we need sharp, driven people to help us grow.

This isn't just sales. You'll be helping homeowners and property owners save trees that have stood for decades. It's meaningful work, and we take it seriously — while having fun doing it.



The Role

You'll be the voice of Save The Ash Tree Co. — calling inbound leads who have already expressed interest in our services, following up on inquiries, and booking treatment appointments. This is a phone-first role: you'll spend most of your time in conversation, building rapport, answering questions, and closing bookings.

Hours: 3–4 hours per day, part-time

Schedule: To be coordinated based on U.S. Central Time business hours

Location: Remote – Philippines



What You'll Do

Call inbound leads who have inquired about ash tree treatment services

Conduct outbound follow-up calls to warm prospects

Educate potential customers on the Emerald Ash Borer threat and our injection treatment process

Answer questions clearly and confidently about our services, pricing, and process

Book service appointments and confirm scheduling details

Keep accurate notes in our CRM (Help Scout) after each call

Communicate any lead feedback or objections back to the team



What We're Looking For:

Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be speaking with American homeowners daily

Background in biology, environmental science, or a related field — or strong personal interest in plant health, ecology, or agriculture

Phone confidence — you genuinely enjoy talking to people and don't shy away from asking for the close

Self-motivated and reliable — you show up, hit your hours, and manage your time well working remotely

Coachable — you'll go through our training program and follow our call process



Bonus if you have:

Prior sales or customer service experience (phone-based preferred)

Experience with CRM tools

Knowledge of invasive species, tree care, or horticulture





Compensation

$4.00 USD per hour (part-time, approx. 3–4 hours/day)

$10.00 USD bonus per confirmed booking you close

Paid [weekly/biweekly — your preference]



This structure rewards closers. A rep booking 2–3 jobs per shift can meaningfully increase their take-home above the hourly base.



Training

Full training provided. You do not need prior tree care knowledge — we will teach you everything about EAB, our treatment process, and how to handle common customer questions and objections. What we can't teach is the drive to pick up the phone and close. That needs to come from you.



Duration

We only run for about 6 months of the year. 



To Apply

Please respond do this posting.





Upload a short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you're a good fit for this role

Your resume or work history

Your available hours (in Philippine Standard Time)



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor — Talking-Head + Screen Recording (Operator Channel)
description:
READ THIS FIRST — to filter yourself in or out:



The biggest mistake new editors make on talking-head + screen-recording content is __________.



If you can't answer that in 2-3 sentences from your own editing experience (NOT from ChatGPT, NOT from a template), this role isn't for you. I'll skip applications that don't lead with that answer.



If your application starts with "I feel that my skills and knowledge make me the ideal candidate" — I will skip it. I'm looking for one specific editor, not a stock cover letter.



---



We're a New Zealand AI-powered marketing agency running a YouTube channel about how we run real marketing clients from Claude Code. We need a long-form video editor to turn 12-18 minute talking-head + screen-recording footage into clean, retention-led YouTube videos every week.



This is NOT a short-form-only role. We have a separate editor for shorts. This role is the long-form anchor.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT:

- 1x 12-18 minute long-form YouTube video per week (steady-state), growing to 1-2/week as we scale

- Source: 30-45 min raw talking-head + 5-10 min ScreenStudio screen recordings per video

- Filming Thursdays NZ time, you turn around by the following Tuesday (5-day window)

- First filming block: Thursday
. First edit due Tuesday
.

- Reference channels: Liam Ottley, Jack Roberts, Tiny Tapes — clean fast cuts, screen overlays, on-screen text labels for technical terms



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT:

- Cutting jump-cuts every 4-8 seconds — operator energy, never slow but never frantic

- B-roll layering — overlaying screen recordings at the right 
nts without burying the face

- On-screen text labels — when I say "/handoff" or "MEMORY.md" the text appears clean on screen (technical-term accuracy is required)

- Captions auto-gen in Premiere or DaVinci, reviewed for technical-term accuracy

- Color grade — slightly warm skin, dark cinematic background, never over-saturated

- Anti-hype — NO upbeat agency intro music. NO sound-effect explosions on text reveals. Subtle ambient music under B-roll only.



WHAT I PROVIDE:

- Full script for every video (first 4 episodes already written)

- Edit notes per episode (what to cut, where B-roll goes)

- Reference timeline from a previous video once we're 2-3 episodes in

- Style guide locked in week 1 (fonts, colors, lower-thirds)



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW:

- DaVinci Resolve OR Premiere Pro (your pick)

- Reliable file handover workflow (
, Dropbox, or Google Drive — your suggestion)



TOOLS THAT WOULD HELP (BONUS):

- ScreenStudio (Mac — my source material comes from this)

- Capcut for fast shorts cuts (we may extend this role into shorts later)



HOURS + COMMITMENT:

- Per video: 4-6 hours edit time

- Weekly: 1 long-form to start, growing to 1-2/week

- 4-week paid trial first, then per-video pricing locks in



PAY:

- Test edit: 5-minute extract from real footage, $15 USD paid regardless of outcome

- Trial (first 4 weeks): $10-18 USD per video, depending on portfolio + test edit quality

- Post-trial: $25-35 USD per long-form video, output-based from week 5 onward

- Long-term scope (3+ months in): potential to grow into an editing lead role with our existing shorts editor reporting to you. $700-1,000 USD/month full-time.



HOW TO APPLY:



Send me three things, in this order:



1. Your 2-3 sentence answer to: "What's the biggest mistake new editors make on talking-head + screen-recording content?" (from your own editing experience, not ChatGPT)



2. 2-3 long-form YouTube editing samples you've personally edited. Send DIRECT video links (Vimeo, YouTube, or specific Drive file URLs — NOT Drive folders, NOT showreels). Add timestamps showing your cuts.



3. Your per-video rate + how many videos per week you can commit to.



I'll reply within 48 hours and pay $15 USD for a 5-minute test edit if your samples fit.



WHAT I WILL NOT REPLY TO:

- Agency-style
s ("we are a team of 50 talented editors")

- Drive folder portfolios (send direct video links only)

- Editors who only do gaming / vlog / lifestyle content

- Anyone whose answer to question 1 reads like ChatGPT

- Anyone who applies without watching 1 minute of the reference channels first

title: AI Creative & Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT RUAH CREATIVE HOUSE



Ruah Creative House is a Kingdom-first video production and content strategy agency. "Ruah" is the Hebrew word for breath, spirit, or wind. We serve churches, faith-based nonprofits, and Christian founders through video production, content strategy, and creative partnership. We believe content is discipleship at scale.



Our founder, Eric Munoz Jr., built RCH from 25+ years of pastoral ministry and creative work. Every client relationship is a Kingdom assignment.



---



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR



You live and breathe AI. You're the kind of person who reads the changelogs, runs your own experiments, and builds little tools on a Saturday because you can't help yourself.



You should know AI better than the whole team does. We need someone who can take the team's repetitive tasks, awkward bottlenecks, and "there has to be a faster way" 
nts and turn them into agents, prompts, and systems that actually work.



If you've been waiting for a role where you actually get paid to play with the latest tools and ship real solutions, this is it.



---



THE ROLE



You are Ruah Creative House's internal AI brain. Your job is to make every tea
mber faster, sharper, and more creative. You'll spend your time in three buckets:



1. BUILD: Design and deploy AI agents that automate routine tasks (lead research, content drafting, asset prep, internal QA, voice-matched copywriting, and more).

2. OPTIMIZE: Audit how the team uses AI and tighten it. Better prompts, better workflows, better tool stacks.

3. COACH & IDEATE: Sit with tea
mbers one-on-one and help them get more out of the tools they already have.



Note: VOH (Voice of Hope) functions as an RCH client, so there is natural project overlap with that work as well.



---



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



AI Agent Development

- Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate routine tasks for tea
mbers

- Maintain and iterate on existing agents based on team feedback

- Document each agent so tea
mbers know what it does, how to use it, and where its limits are



AI Optimization

- Audit how the team currently uses AI and identify where workflows can be tightened

- Recommend and implement better prompts, tools, and stacks

- Stay current on new AI capabilities and bring relevant ones into the company



Prompt Engineering & Team Coaching

- Help tea
mbers craft sharper, more effective prompts for their specific roles

- Build a shared prompt library tailored to RCH's voice, ICP, and workflows

- Run short internal trainings or 1:1 sessions to level up team AI literacy



Hands-On Execution

- Run tasks directly using Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, and other tools as needed

- Generate visual assets, video concepts, scripts, and creative ideation for internal and client work

- Partner with the creative team on AI-assisted production where it adds value



Reporting

- Brief Eric weekly on what was built, what was optimized, and what's queued next

- Track which agents and prompts the team is actually using (and which aren't)



---



JOB STRUCTURE



- Type: Part-time, fully remote

- Hours: 20 hours per week (minimum)

- Schedule: Flexible, with EST overlap recommended. Split shift acceptable.

- Meetings: Weekly sync with Eric. Monthly 1:1.

- Growth Path: This role is built to expand as RCH's AI footprint grows.



COMPENSATION



- Base Pay: $350 to $450 USD per month (paid bi-weekly via Wise)

- Hourly Equivalent: $4 to $5.50 USD per hour

- PHP Range: PHP 19,250 to PHP 24,750 per month

- All AI tools required for the role (Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, etc.) are fully paid for by Ruah Creative House



---



TOOLS YOU'LL USE (PAID FOR BY RCH)



- Claude (Anthropic): Primary LLM for agent building and voice-matched writing

- ChatGPT (OpenAI): Secondary LLM, custom GPTs, experimentation

- Higgsfield: AI video and visual generation

- Google Chat, Motion, Loom, Notion

- Open to your stack: n8n, Zapier, Make, Cursor, ElevenLabs, Runway, etc.



---



MUST HAVES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



- Stable internet with backup plan

- Fluent written English

- Demonstrated experience building AI agents, automations, or workflows (personal projects count)

- Deep working knowledge of Claude and/or ChatGPT, including system prompts and advanced prompting techniques

- Strong prompt engineering skills -- you can teach this and explain why prompts work

- Self-directed: you can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution

- Comfortable engaging in faith-based work environments

- Prior experience working with churches, ministries, or faith-based organizations (required)



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with video AI tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Pika, Sora) and image AI (Midjourney, Flux)

- Background in automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier)

- Coding/scripting ability (Python, JavaScript)

- Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, etc.)

- Past work with creative agencies, video teams, or faith-based organizations



---



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: Ruah AI Creative, [Your Name], [Your Favorite AI Tool]



Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



1. Short paragraph (5-10 sentences): What have you built? What tools do you use daily? Where's your edge?

2. 2-3 examples of AI work you've done (custom GPT link, agent/automation screenshot, prompt library, side project)

3. Paste one prompt you've written that you think is exceptional, and explain in 2-3 sentences why it works

4. Tell us about an AI build that broke or didn't perform the way you expected. What went wrong, and how did you fix it? (2-4 sentences)

5. Short paragraph: If you joined Ruah on day one, what's the first AI agent or system you'd want to build for a small creative agency, and why?

6. Screenshot of your current internet speed test

7. Optional: 60-second Loom walking through one piece of AI work you're proud of



---



INTERVIEW FOCUS



- Your hands-on experience with AI agents, prompts, and automations

- Live problem-solving: we will give you a real RCH workflow on the spot and ask you to walk through how you'd build for it. We're watching for systems thinking, not tool name-dropping.

- How you teach and translate AI to non-technical people

- Comfort level with faith-based work environments



HIRING PATH



- Application review

- Short paid trial project (1-2 small AI builds, scoped and paid separately)

- Final interview with Eric

- Offer



---



DEAL BREAKERS



- Surface-level AI knowledge (you've used ChatGPT a few times but can't actually build anything)

- Ghosting or unannounced absences

- Inability to teach or explain your work to non-technical tea
mbers

- Discomfort with or dismissiveness toward the faith foundation of the work

- Using AI to ship sloppy work -- we expect taste, judgment, and quality control

- Agency or team submissions (this seat belongs to one dedicated person)

- Freelancers unwilling to commit to a consistent 20-hour weekly schedule

- No prior experience working with churches, ministries, or faith-based organizations



If you build, break, rebuild, and can't stop tinkering with the latest model the day it drops, we want to hear from you.

Ruah Creative House is a Kingdom-first creative studio serving churches, nonprofits, and faith-driven leaders. We're hiring a Client Experience Specialist to be the operational heartbeat of our client relationships, from onboarding through delivery.



You'll own the client journey: managing onboarding workflows, tracking deliverables, coordinating communication between clients and our internal team, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. This role is the bridge between what our clients need and what our team delivers.



Full-time | 40 hours/week | EST overlap required (split shift acceptable)



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage client onboarding from signed contract through first deliverable

- Track project milestones, deadlines, and deliverable handoffs

- Maintain clear communication with clients via
 and messaging tools

- Flag bottlenecks and escalate blockers to the creative/production team

- Keep CRM and project management systems updated and accurate

- Handle follow-ups, check-ins, and scheduling coordination



REQUIREMENTS:

- Proven experience working inside structured service delivery and client success systems (onboarding workflows, communication tracking, deliverable handoffs, scheduling) — required

- CRM or client portal experience (Dubsado, HoneyBook, ClickUp, or similar) — highly preferred

- Dubsado experience specifically — preferred

- Excellent written English communication

- Self-directed and organized — you don't need to be chased

- Faith alignment — we are a Christian organization and this role reflects our values in every client interaction



DEAL BREAKERS — Do not apply if:

- You represent an agency or team; this is a dedicated individual seat

- You're a freelancer unwilling to commit to a fixed Monday-Friday schedule

- You have no prior experience working with churches, ministries, or faith-based organizations

Describe how you would handle a client who hasn't responded to 3 follow-ups about a missing asset that's blocking production.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
40 hours, Monday to Friday. You will be working UK business hours: 9am–6pm UK time. That is 5pm–2am Manila time (GMT, Oct–Mar) or 4pm–1am Manila time (BST, Mar–Oct). This is not negotiable — I need you online and responsive during my working day. If you cannot commit to a UK-hours night shift long-term, please do not apply.



I'm a UK-based entrepreneur running multiple businesses simultaneously — an outbound sales agency, a premium sports & wellness club opening in 2026, plus a couple of other ventures. I need a sharp, proactive executive VA who can become my second brain across all of it, working alongside me in real time on UK hours.



This is not a data-entry role. I need someone who can take a voice note fro
 that says "Tell Alan in our next sync I want to revisit the Q1 plan, and chase Paolo on the lease" and turn that into the right actions: a tracker update, a calendar tag, a follow-up reminder, the right level of urgency. Judgment matters more than speed.



What you'll be doing day-to-day:



Voice note triage. I'll send you a lot of voice notes throughout the day. You listen, extract actions, and update my personal tracker (Google Sheets / Notion). You tag urgency, assign them to the right business, and route them to my to-do list.

Inbox management. You'll be in my Gmail live during UK hours. Every new
, you screenshot and send it to me via WhatsApp/Slack with a one-line summary. I tell you how to action it, you action it (draft reply, file, flag, archive). Over time you'll learn what I want without asking.

Calendar management. You own my calendar. If I ask "what's on today?" you tell me. If I need to move things, you move them. You proactively flag conflicts, protect deep work blocks, and book travel/meetings on my behalf.

CRM management. Keeping my CRM clean and up-to-date (HubSpot or similar). Also keeping a client's CRM clean for a fractional engagement I run.

Event & meeting coordination. Booking restaurants, coordinating with stakeholders (investors, partners, suppliers), sending calendar invites, prepping me with a one-line brief before each meeting.

Light project tracking. Maintaining trackers across my businesses (e.g. a project tracker for the club opening, a deal tracker for the agency).



How we'll work together:



Most of my instructions come as voice notes. You need to be comfortable listening, interpreting, and acting — not just transcribing.

I move fast and communicate in plain language. I don't want to manage you tightly; I want someone who anticipates.

Because you're working UK hours, I expect real-time responsiveness during the workday — not async batches.

Discretion is critical. You'll see commercial, financial, and personal information.



Skill Requirements:



Able and willing to work UK business hours (9am–6pm UK) long-term. Night shift in Manila. Non-negotiable.

Excellent written English — near-native level.

3+ years of Executive VA experience, ideally for a founder or C-suite executive in the US/UK/AU. UK-client experience is a strong plus.

Strong with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs) — daily-driver level.

CRM experience — HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar. You should know how to keep one clean, build views, and chase missing data.

Comfortable with voice notes as the primary input. Core to the role.

Familiar with: Notion, Slack, WhatsApp, Calendly. Bonus: 

Proactive judgment. Tell me in your application about a time you made a judgment call your boss didn't expect.

Reliable internet and a quiet working setup suitable for a UK-hours night shift. Backup connection preferred.

title: PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

title: Commission-Based Sales Representative
description:
We are looking for a Commission-Based Sales Representative to help follow up with warm leads interested in our Service Operator Business opportunity.



This role is focused on lead follow-up, basic qualification, explaining the high-level offer, and scheduling serious prospects for a final call with the CEO.



This is not a cold-calling role and not a full closing role. You will be working with people who have already shown interest. Your main responsibility is to determine whether they are a good fit and move qualified prospects to the next step.



Responsibilities

Follow up with warm inbound leads

Contact prospects by phone, text, and

Ask basic qualifying questions

Explain the Service Operator Business opportunity at a high level

Make sure prospects understand this is a business opportunity, not a job

Make sure prospects understand there is an investment required

Schedule qualified prospects for a final call with the CEO

Update notes and lead status in the CRM

Follow up consistently until the lead is booked, disqualified, or no longer responsive

Compensation



Compensation is performance-based:



$25 per qualified completed call

+ $500 bonus per closed deal



A qualified completed call means the prospect attends the scheduled call, understands this is a business opportunity, understands there is an investment required, and is a realistic candidate for starting a service-based business.



The $500 closed-deal bonus is paid when the prospect becomes a paying client and payment clears.

description:

 campaigns you have coordinated in the past.

title: Online Product Data Research & Analysis
description:
Amazon Data Research & Analysis Specialist

Remote  ·  Part-Time to Start  ·  Full-Time Path Available



Pay PART TIME - $265-$325/month USD Depending on experience (approx. 15,425 PHP) prorated to hours

FULL TIME compensation discussed upon completion of ramp up period along with a bonus structure available

Hours: 10 hrs/week to start · Full-time (20-25 hrs/week) considered after ramp-up period

Schedule: Flexible · Overlap with US business hours preferred

Location Remote — Overseas applicants strongly encouraged to apply





ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are a growing online Amazon business looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated Data Research Specialist to join our remote team. Your primary responsibility will be researching and evaluating products from online retail websites, analyzing pricing and profitability data, and maintaining organized records in Google Sheets.

This is a long-term position with real room to grow. We provide full training and step-by-step SOPs from day one. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything — we are looking for someone who is eager to learn, follows directions carefully, and takes pride in accurate work.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

– Research and evaluate products daily by scanning approved online retail websites, leverage amazon analysis tools and website sales manually

– Analyze each product using specialized research tools (training provided) to assess pricing, fees, profit, and sales trends

– Log all research data accurately into our custom tracking system and Google Sheets templates

– Meet weekly research quotas and quality benchmarks

– Communicate daily with end-of-day progress summaries

– Attend brief weekly check-ins to review performance and receive feedback

– Apply coaching and feedback quickly — we invest in people who invest in themselves







WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Required

– Minimum of 1 year of working for an Amazon reseller specifically sourcing products for their catalog

– Strong written and spoken English — you communicate clearly, ask good questions, and follow detailed instructions

– Background or experience in data analysis, research, data entry, or a related analytical field

– Comfortable working with Google Sheets (sorting, filtering, basic formulas)

– High attention to detail — accuracy in this role directly affects business outcomes

– Reliable internet connection and personal computer

– Self-motivated — able to work independently and consistently hit daily targets

– Open to coaching, feedback, and continuous improvement

– Familiarity with data research or price comparison tools such as KEEPA, Seller AMP SAS

– Experience supporting US-based remote employers is a bonus



WHAT WE OFFER

– Part-time start (20 hrs/week) with a clear path to full-time — after a 1-2 month ramp-up period, strong performers will be considered for a full-time offer

– PTO arranged upon transition to full-time employment

– Bonus structure developed collaboratively with the selected candidate based on performance (At owner’s discretion based on ramp up period completion)

– Full onboarding training with step-by-step SOPs provided from day one

– Consistent coaching and feedback so you always know how to improve

– Clear performance metrics — no guessing about how you are doing

– Long-term, stable position with a team that values loyalty and growth



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



– A short introduction (3–5 sentences) about your background, why you are a good fit for a data research role, and any analysis tools you may have worked with

– Your answer to this question: What is your favorite color, and why?

– Your answer to this question: What does an iPhone do?



Applications that are incomplete or appear copy-pasted will not be reviewed. We read every application personally and respond to everyone who puts in the effort.

title: Appointment Setter / Acquisition Appointment Coordinator
description:

We’re looking for high-output appointment setters who can confidently handle inbound leads from individuals interested in acquiring an online business, qualify them effectively, and schedule strategy calls with our Acquisition Specialists.



This is not a passive customer support role.



This is a performance-driven sales position where your ability to communicate clearly, stay organized, and move conversations forward directly impacts revenue.



You will be speaking with motivated inbound leads who have already expressed interest in acquiring a business through Launch Vector.



Your responsibility is to:



Qualify interest

- Control the flow of the conversation

- Gather accurate information

- Keep HubSpot updated

- Get qualified prospects booked and confirmed for calls with our Acquisition Specialists



What You’ll Be Doing (Daily Responsibilities)

- Make 100+ outbound calls per day to inbound leads and scheduled follow-ups

- Speak with potential acquisition partners interested in purchasing online businesses

- Qualify leads based on capital availability, seriousness, goals, and timeline

- Schedule appointments with Acquisition Specialists

- Confirm upcoming appointments and reduce no-show rates

- Reschedule missed appointments and reactivate cold leads

- Maintain detailed notes and communication logs inside HubSpot CRM

- Keep pipelines organized and updated in real time

- Follow structured call frameworks while still sounding natural and conversational

- Coordinate closely with the acquisitions team to ensure smooth handoffs



This Role Is For Someone Who:

- Is comfortable being on the phone for most of the day

- Can confidently handle high call volume

- Understands how to guide conversations without sounding robotic

- Is highly organized and detail-oriented

- Learns software quickly and can operate HubSpot efficiently

- Can multitask between calls, CRM updates, and scheduling

- Takes ownership over outcomes, not just activity

- Has strong communication skills and good judgment

- Wants to grow inside a high-performance sales environment



Requirements

- Prior experience in appointment setting, SDR, sales, or phone-based roles

- Strong English communication skills

- Experience using HubSpot or similar CRMs

- Reliable internet and professional remote work setup

- Ability to work independently and maintain consistency

- Comfortable hitting KPIs and call targets daily



Preferred Experience

- High-ticket sales environment

- Business acquisition, finance, investing, or eCommerce familiarity

- Inbound lead qualification

- Calendar management and appointment coordination

- Handling follow-up sequences and reactivation calls



KPIs & Expectations

- 100+ calls per day

- Fast response times to new inbound leads

- Accurate and organized HubSpot notes

- High appointment show rates

- Consistent follow-up execution

- Strong communication between setter and acquisitions team



Compensation

- Base pay + performance bonuses

- Bonus opportunities tied to qualified appointments

- Growth opportunities within Launch Vector’s acquisitions team



About Launch Vector



Launch Vector acquires and operates eCommerce businesses with capital partners. Our team manages acquisitions, operations, growth, and scaling across a portfolio of online brands.



We move fast, value clear communication, and prioritize people who take ownership and execute consistently.



If you’re sharp on the phone, organized in systems, and thrive in a high-performance environment, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Hiking, Travel & Cultural Logistics Assistant – 21-Island Philippines Expedition (Non-Voice / Part-Time to Full-Time)
description:
Are you highly organized, resourceful, and curious about travel, culture, and the outdoors? Do you know how to navigate the real information channels in the Philippines, including
 groups, Messenger threads, LGU pages, local referrals, and tourism offices?



I am a veteran IT professional preparing for an intensive 8-month solo motorcycle and hiking expedition across 21 major islands in the Philippines for my YouTube project, Stoic Solo Hiker.



This journey will cover rugged mountains, provincial routes, ferry crossings, local festivals, wellness tracking, live music, cultural experiences, and authentic day-to-day Filipino life. I am building a support system that allows me to stay focused on the road, the hikes, and the story. To do that, I need a reliable, sharp, and independent assistant to help with logistics, travel coordination, and cultural research.



Please note: this is not a video editing or simple data-entry job. This role is a professional collaboration built on trust, independent thinking, and clear communication. You will not be following a rigid checklist. You will help gather information, confirm details, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions in a real-world travel environment.



A lot of important safety, transit, hiking, and event information in the Philippines does not appear on official websites. It often lives inside
 groups, LGU Messenger threads, local guide networks, and personal referrals. I need someone who knows how to navigate those channels and get direct, double-confirmed facts.



Main Responsibilities:

Adventure & Hiking Coordination

You will not be planning major hikes from scratch. For the most serious mountains, I expect to work with experienced hike organizers and local guides. Your role will be to help coordinate with those organizers, manage communication, confirm details, and keep the logistics clear while my days are busy on the road.



Permit Management & Clear Directions

Research and organize permit requirements for treks, waterfalls, protected areas, and cultural sites. When possible, help coordinate with local authorities to pull permits ahead of time to reduce friction, or provide step-by-step instructions on what office I need to visit and what documents or fees are required.



Transit, Ferry & Drone Research

Message or call tourism offices, LGUs, local guides, ferry/Ro-Ro operators, and lodging providers to confirm schedules, availability, restrictions, and local conditions. For drone use, help identify local rules, restrictions, contacts, and red flags before I make the final decision to fly.



Destination Briefs

Create simple, clear destination briefs before I arrive. These should include how to get there, where to stay, who to contact, permits needed, estimated costs, risks, backup options, and what still needs confirmation.



Music & Nightlife Scouting

Research local music venues and events tailored to my interests, including Filipino hip-hop, local jazz, authentic OPM, live bands, and cultural performances.



Wellness & Fitness Sourcing

Map out quality local gyms along the route and help source authentic traditional Hilot massage providers for recovery after difficult hikes.



Cinematic & Cultural Scouting

Find strong sunrise/sunset viewpoints, overlooked local places, and off-the-beaten-path locations that could elevate the storytelling. On recovery days, help find interactive cultural experiences such as traditional cooking classes, regional food experiences, or local dance workshops such as Tinikling.



Language & Cultural Support

Provide conversational practice in Filipino/Tagalog and basic Bisaya during regular alignment calls in the preparation phase.



What I Am Looking For:

Excellent English and Tagalog are required.



Bisaya/Cebuano fluency is a strong advantage, but not mandatory if you are excellent at finding and communicating with reliable regional contacts.



You are skilled at using
, Messenger, TikTok, YouTube, Google Maps, LGU pages, local referrals, and direct messages to find accurate current information.



You never guess. You confirm.



You are comfortable messaging or calling strangers, local offices, venues, operators, tourism offices, ferry companies, guides, and organizers politely and professionally.



You are independent, detail-oriented, calm when plans change, and genuinely interested in showing the real Philippines, not just standard tourist spots.



Experience with hiking, mountaineering, tourism, event research, cultural research, or extensive provincial travel is highly preferred.



This Role Is NOT For You If:

You disappear or go silent without updates.



You guess or assume information instead of confirming it.



You prefer passive, repetitive copy-paste tasks.



You need every small step micromanaged.



You are uncomfortable using
, Messenger, or direct outreach to find local information.



Pay, Schedule & Benefits:

Type: Independent Contractor



Preparation Phase: August–September, approximately 4–8 hours per month for route research, workflow building, and language practice.



Expedition Phase: October–June 2027, approximately 5–20 hours per week depending on travel complexity and performance.



Rate: $6.00–$7.00 USD per hour depending on experience, reliability, and regional language skills.



Perks: Monthly connectivity/communications stipend provided for the right person to support stable internet and mobile access while helping track the journey.



Selection Process:

Initial screening will be based on your written application. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test project that simulates real-world expedition coordination.



The paid test may include:



A written logistics task based on a Philippine hiking/travel scenario.



A short WhatsApp call where we discuss your findings and walk through a realistic travel situation to see how you organize information, ask questions, and propose next steps.



How to Apply:

Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph or
: 



Your subject line must be exactly: Hiking & Cultural Assistant – [Your Name] – Ready for the Road



In your message, please answer these questions:



What languages do you speak fluently, and what regions of the Philippines do you know best?



Briefly describe your personal experience with hiking, outdoor groups, tourism, events, cultural research, or provincial travel in the Philippines.



If you do not speak Bisaya/Cebuano, explain step-by-step how you would find and double-confirm a mountain guide’s contact information in a remote Visayan province where the information is not listed on Google.



Pick one specific region or city in the Philippines. Briefly explain how you would find and verify:



A localized, authentic Hilot massage therapist, not a commercial tourist spa.



A hidden or lesser-known spot for cinematic sunrise or sunset footage.



The current local rules or restrictions for flying a drone.



A local contact, school, or community group where an outsider could respectfully try a traditional cooking class or cultural dance such as Tinikling.



A way to check if there are Pinoy hip-hop gigs, jazz nights, OPM events, or live music happening in that area during a specific week.



Why does the Stoic Solo Hiker project appeal to you personally?



Applications with incorrect subject lines or missing answers may not be reviewed.

title: Shipping Operations Specialist
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented Shipping Operations Specialist to join our dynamic logistics team. This role will handle comprehensive shipping operations across multiple service lines including Less Than Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and UPS small parcel services. The ideal candidate will manage end-to-end shipping processes while providing exceptional customer service and operational support.



Key Responsibilities



LTL Operations



* Process LTL shipment quotes and bookings through our TMS platform and carrier systems

* Generate and review Bills of Lading (BOLs) for accuracy before carrier pickup

* Coordinate with LTL carrier network

* Handle freight classification using NMFC guidelines and assist customers with proper commodity coding

* Manage volume shipments requiring special handling

* Process accessorial services including liftgate, inside delivery, residential delivery, and appointment scheduling

* Monitor transit times and proactively communicate to customers

* Handle reconsignments and service failures with alternative carrier solutions



Truckload Operations



* Coordinate full truckload shipments with 45,000+ carrier network

* Manage flatbed, dry van, and specialized equipment requirements

* Process truck-in-hand bookings and capacity management

* Handle multi-stop deliveries and complex routing requirements

* Manage detention, lumper fees, and accessorial charges



UPS Small Parcel Operations



* Process UPS shipments through WorldShip, TMS, and integration platforms

* Process international shipments and customs documentation



Customer Service & Communication



* Respond to quote requests within targeted timeframe

* Provide proactive shipment tracking and status updates

* Coordinate with billing team if needed

* Process claims and coordinate with carriers for resolution

* Maintain customer communication through
, phone, and other communication channels



Documentation & Compliance



* Generate accurate BOLs with proper commodity descriptions and handling instructions

* Ensure compliance with DOT regulations and carrier requirements

* Maintain proper documentation for hazmat and dangerous goods shipments

* Process export documentation and customs requirements

* Handle weight certificates and freight classification disputes



Required Qualifications



* Experience: 2+ years in freight brokerage, logistics, or transportation operations

* Technical Skills: Proficiency with TMS systems, preferably MyUnishippers platform

* Industry Knowledge: Understanding of LTL freight classification, NMFC codes, and carrier operations

* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Software: Advanced Excel skills, experience with WorldShip, and CRM systems

* Problem Solving: Ability to resolve shipping issues and find alternative solutions quickly

* Attention to Detail: Accuracy in documentation and data entry

* Multi-tasking: Ability to manage multiple shipments and priorities simultaneously



 Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with UPS partnership programs and small parcel operations

* Knowledge of international shipping and customs procedures

* Previous experience in customer-facing logistics roles

* Understanding of freight insurance and liability coverage



What We Offer



* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

* Professional development opportunities

* Collaborative team environment with direct leadership access

* Opportunity to work with diverse customer base across multiple industries

* Opportunity to grow and advance within the company



About BP Freight



Best Price Freight is a full-service logistics brokerage and proud member of the Unishippers network. With over 12 years of experience, we provide reliable, hands-on shipping solutions across the United States. We serve industries including retail, food & beverage, manufacturing, and e-commerce with a focus on personalized, relationship-driven service.

As one of the largest UPS partners and a top LTL operator, we offer nationwide coverage with competitive pricing and flexibility that large corporations can't match. Our team provides direct access, responsive service, and the personal attention that makes us easy to reach when it matters most.

title: OUTBOUND SALES & COORDINATION
description:
---



## WorkBench by Novai — Outbound Sales & Operations Coordinator

**Part-Time · Remote (Philippines) · Reports to Team Manager**



---



### About WorkBench



WorkBench by Novai is a managed home services marketplace operating in the Los Angeles market. We connect vetted, credentialed workers — landscapers, cleaners, handymen, property maintenance crews — with clients: property managers, HOAs, commercial accounts, and homeowners. We are an early-stage, fast-moving platform. The team is lean, the tools are live, and every hire compounds directly to revenue.



---



### The Role



We need a sharp operator who can run structured outbound at volume, keep our CRM clean, and move deals forward without being babysat. You'll work directly inside 
 and HubSpot daily — not as support, as an executor. You will own your pipeline rows, your sequence steps, and your follow-through.



This is a two-sided outreach role: you'll work both the supply side (recruiting workers and contractors onto the platform) and the demand side (signing up property managers, HOAs, and commercial accounts as clients).



**Hours:** ~20 hrs/week, Pacific Time overlap required (minimum 4 hours daily Mon–Fri)

**Compensation:** Competitive for Philippines market, performance bonus tied to conversions



---



### What You'll Do Day-to-Day



**
 (60% of your time)**

- Execute live outbound sequences across 6 active tracks (SEQ-A through SEQ-F) — each with a different angle: platform poach, fatigue, cold virgin outreach, demand-side property pitch

- Dial outbound using Apollo's US dialer — you are making calls, not just sending
s

- Manage deliverability hygiene: bounce monitoring, reply tagging, sequence pausing on unresponsive contacts

- Enrich and update contact records from our scored lead lists (1,000+ warm, tiered accounts)

- Log all call outcomes same-day — no backlogs



**HubSpot (25% of your time)**

- Own the three active pipelines: Contractors, Property Managers, PAWS

- Move deals through stages based on call outcomes — no orphaned contacts sitting in the wrong stage

- Set follow-up tasks and reminders, trigger internal notifications when a lead is ready for founder call handoff

- Build and run contact lists for re-engagement on stale deals

- Weekly pipeline report to the team: deals added, moved, stalled, won



**Platform Coordination (15% of your time)**

- Assist with worker onboarding coordination — track which contractors have registered, verified identity, and activated their subscription on 
vaisystems.online

- Follow up with workers who started signup but didn't complete verification (Tier 1–4 pipeline)

- Coordinate with the team manager on job posting activity from B2B clients — flag when new accounts go live and need a worker match

- Handle basic client and worker communications for scheduling and status questions



---



### You Must Have



- **
 experience — non-negotiable.** You need to know sequences, dialer, contact filters, and A/B testing inside Apollo without a tutorial. We are not teaching the tool.

- **HubSpot experience — non-negotiable.** Pipeline management, deal stages, task creation, and contact properties. HubSpot Starter or above.

- **Outbound calling comfort.** You will be calling US businesses in a professional context. Neutral English accent or better. No hesitation about cold calls.

- Structured self-management: you will have a target list, a sequence, and a deadline — and you will hit it without being followed up on

- Google Meet for team standups and call recording (auto-transcription, no additional tools)

- Strong written English — your
s go to US property managers and business owners



---



### You'll Excel If You Have



- Experience doing outbound for a marketplace, SaaS, or staffing platform — two-sided outreach is different from single-product sales

- Familiarity with home services, property management, or contractor industries

- Prior SDR or BDR role under a structured sales manager

- Experience working with a US-based startup remotely from the Philippines



---



### What You're Walking Into



- Live platform with real workers, real clients, real revenue. Not a pre-launch idea.

- Active Apollo workspace with scored lead lists (1,750 leads across supply and demand)

- Three live HubSpot pipelines, sequences already built — you're operating them, not building from scratch

- A team of two other SDRs and a manager (Manila-based) — this is a known culture

- Direct visibility to Ajay (Founder) on performance. Short feedback loops. No corporate lag.



---



### How to Apply



Send a short Loom video (3 minutes max) answering:

1. Walk us through how you ran a sequence in Apollo — what was the product, who were you targeting, what was your reply rate

2. Show us one HubSpot pipeline you managed — how did you keep it clean



Applications without the Loom will not be reviewed. No recruiters.



---



**This role is for someone who treats a lead list like an asset and a CRM like a ledger — not a dumping ground.**

title: Senior GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation Expert
description:
Job Type: Part-time 

Schedule: Fully flexible — work when it suits you. We communicate async via Slack. No fixed hours.

Salary: $1,000 – $1,500/month USD 

Start Date: Immediate



About Us

We're LMD Growth Agency, a digital marketing agency based in South Florida. We manage paid search, paid social, SEO, web development, and marketing automation for a portfolio of established US clients across home services, automotive, healthcare, and retail. Our clients aren't startups — they're real businesses doing real revenue, and they expect real results.

We're not looking for a button-pusher or a generalist VA who "knows GHL." We're looking for a true expert — someone who lives in the platform, thinks in workflows and triggers, and knows the difference between an automation that looks good on paper and one that actually drives bookings.

If you've been the person at your agency who fixes everyone else's broken GHL setups, this role is for you.



What You'll Actually Do



Audit existing GHL sub-accounts across multiple clients and identify what's broken, underperforming, or missing entirely

Build and optimize end-to-end automations: lead intake, nurture sequences, appointment booking, reactivation campaigns, review requests, missed-call text-back, pipeline automations

Design trigger logic that handles real-world edge cases — duplicate contacts, multi-source leads, status changes, conditional branching

Set up and maintain conversion tracking, custom fields, tags, and pipeline logic that actually reflects how each client's business works

Handle A2P 10DLC registrations end-to-end and troubleshoot rejections when they happen

Integrate GHL with external tools — Zapier, 
, webhooks, Twilio, Google Ads, Meta, and custom APIs

Build reusable snapshots so we can deploy proven systems across new clients fast

Analyze workflow performance — open rates, reply rates, booking rates, conversion drop-offs — and propose specific optimizations with data behind them

Write clear documentation and Loom walkthroughs of every system you build

Communicate proactively in Slack — flag issues before they become problems





Required Experience



Minimum 3 years working in GoHighLevel specifically — not just "marketing automation" in general

Deep mastery of workflows and trigger logic — you understand event triggers vs filters, wait conditions, if/else branches, and how to architect automations that don't break when reality gets messy

Proven A2P 10DLC track record — you've personally registered brands and campaigns and know how to get them approved (and what to do when they get rejected)

Hands-on experience with at least one US-based marketing agency

Strong understanding of GHL custom fields, tags, pipelines, calendars, conversation AI, and the full SMS/email infrastructure

Experience integrating GHL with external tools via webhooks and APIs

Ability to read and debug a workflow that someone else built without breaking it

Strong written English — most of our communication is async via Slack and Loom

Reliable internet and a setup that lets you do focused, quality work

Self-managing — you don't need someone watching over you to deliver





Nice to Have



HighLevel Certified Admin certification

Experience with home services, automotive, or local service business clients

Experience building GHL snapshots deployed across multiple sub-accounts

Basic HTML/CSS for landing page edits within GHL

Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and how lead data flows back into GHL





How We Work

This is a part-time role with real flexibility. We don't care when you work — we care that the work gets done well, that you respond to Slack within a reasonable window during your active days, and that deadlines get hit. Some of our team works mornings, some works nights. As long as you're communicating and delivering, we don't track hours.

What we do expect:



Active on Slack during the days you're working — not radio silence for 3 days

Hit agreed deadlines, or flag early if something is going to slip

Self-manage your workload — we'll give you priorities, you figure out your schedule

Show up to a weekly team check-in (we'll find a time that works for you)



If you need rigid structure and someone telling you what to do hour by hour, this isn't the right fit. If you do your best work when trusted to manage your own time, you'll thrive here.



How to Apply

We're not interested in copy-paste applications. Send us:



A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through the most complex GHL automation you've ever built. Show us the actual workflow on screen. Talk through your trigger logic.

A short written answer: "A client tells you their lead nurture sequence isn't working — replies are low and bookings have dropped 40% in the last 60 days. What are the first 5 things you check inside GHL, and why?"

A second short written answer: "Briefly describe how you handle A2P 10DLC registration and what you do when a campaign gets rejected."

Your hourly rate in USD and weekly availability.

Three GHL features or integrations you've built that you're proud of — one sentence each.



Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Generic applications go straight to the no pile. Strong candidates hear back within 48 hours.



What Working With Us Looks Like



Weekly pay via Wise (no waiting 30 days)

13th month bonus paid in December (pro-rated for part-time)

Performance bonuses tied to client retention and results

Real team — Slack, Loom, weekly check-ins, you're not a ghost

Long-term role with clear path to expanded responsibility as we scale

We invest in your tools — paid subscriptions, training, certifications

Genuine flexibility — we trust adults to manage their own time



We treat our team like partners. We expect the same in return.
